1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Six congruent hat tiles and a clue on nearly every face isolate the one-loop rule on a small irregular graph.
1.natural_language: Draw one closed loop along the visible tile edges. Each number is the exact count of that tile's visible edge segments used by the loop; the loop may not branch or cross. In direct mode, drag from dot to dot and right-click an edge to rule it out. In simplified mode, select an edge and use the mark controls. Certify the finished loop.
